summary: Frontend-only iteration: verified (A) the +/-/reset button BUG FIX and (B) the full new Workout tracker end-to-end on mobile viewport 390x844. (A) Bug-fix CONFIRMED: zoom-in-btn / zoom-out-btn / reset-view-btn are positioned at y=64/118/172 with width=height=44 — fully BELOW the segmented header (y=8-46), visible and tappable on BOTH Explore (/explore) AND Workout (/workout) Exercises segment. Each was tapped 3+ times without overlay interception. (B) Workout tracker end-to-end: seg-exercises / seg-session / seg-history present and switch content. Exercises shows AnatomyViewer + DraggableSheet with all 7 category chips (cat-All/Push/Pull/Legs/Core/Upper/Lower) and exercise list (ex-bench-press, ex-pull-up, ex-squat, etc.). Tapping ex-squat navigated to /exercise/squat showing 3D viewer (quads/glutes highlighted), instructions, primary+secondary chips, and start-workout-btn — tapping it routed to /workout?seg=session with squat pre-added. In Session: stats bar shows Time/Exercises/Sets/Volume (live tick verified — 00:09 after 9s). w-squat-0 and r-squat-0 inputs accept '60'/'8'; addset-squat adds w-squat-1; dup-squat-0 inserts w-squat-2 with original values; done-squat-0 toggles ✓ and pops the rest-timer modal containing rest-30/60/90/120 presets, rest-pause toggling Play/Pause, and rest-skip closes it. finish-workout routed to /summary?id=<uid>&prs=... displaying Workout Complete badge, six stat cards (Duration 0m 09s, Exercises 1, Sets 3, Reps 24, Volume 1440 kg, Muscles 7), Personal Records (Barbell Back Squat: 60 kg + 1440 kg volume), Muscle Activation bars (Rectus Femoris/Vastus Lateralis/Vastus Medialis 100%, Adductor Magnus 50%, etc.), and summary-done. After summary-done → seg-history shows hist-<id> entry; tapping it reopens the same summary ("Workout Complete" visible). A second clean workout (bench-press, 80kg x 10) repeated the full flow successfully (Pectoralis Major 100%, Triceps 50%, Deltoid 50%). Regression: Explore → tap centre → muscle-detail-title 'Latissimus Dorsi' still works; Learn shows 5 lesson cards. Deprecated packages detected: none. SafeAreaView issues detected: none. No red-screen errors. Only previously-known cosmetic RN-web warnings (props.pointerEvents, shadow*, useNativeDriver) persist from iteration_6 — same lines, no new ones.

react_native_issues.issue: Uses inline pointerEvents='box-none' as a JSX prop (warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'). Cosmetic; tap behaviour is correct. Reference: /app/frontend/src/anatomy/AnatomyViewer.tsx:196

Carried over from iteration_6 — shadow* style props deprecated on RN-web (use boxShadow) and useNativeDriver falls back to JS animations on web. Native-only concerns; cosmetic on web. Reference: /app/frontend/src/anatomy/DraggableSheet.tsx:81-84 and :32

action_items: (Optional, low-priority) Expo Router stack accumulation: after the flow exercise/[id] → router.replace('/(tabs)/workout?seg=session') → router.push('/summary') → router.replace('/(tabs)/workout'), three instances of the /(tabs)/workout screen end up mounted (querySelectorAll('[data-testid="seg-history"]').length === 3 in that state). All three share the same WorkoutProvider context so functionality is unaffected, but it is a small memory leak / potential cause of double-renders. Consider router.dismissAll() before final replace or using router.navigate to dedupe. NOT a blocker.

(Optional cosmetic) Migrate AnatomyViewer's inline pointerEvents JSX prop on the controls View to style={{ pointerEvents: 'box-none' }} (mirrors what was suggested for explore.tsx/workout.tsx in iteration_6).
critical_code_review_comments: workoutStore.tsx saveJSON double-encodes: storage.setItem already JSON.stringifies (index.web.ts:31), but saveJSON additionally JSON.stringify()s before calling it. Decoded round-trip still works because loadJSON re-parses, but this stores values like "\"[...]\"" (a JSON-encoded JSON string) in AsyncStorage — slight bloat and a foot-gun for any code that reads HISTORY_KEY directly with AsyncStorage.getItem. Suggest: storage.setItem(key, v) directly (no extra stringify) and have loadJSON call storage.getItem<any>(key, fallback) — the Storage class is already JSON-aware.

RestTimer setPreset resets the elapsed time when active timer is running — good UX. However the auto-close on left===0 fires onClose() after 600ms which closes the Modal but the timer interval cleanup happens via the useEffect cleanup on next render; verified no crash but adds a 600ms idle interval. Minor.
AnatomyViewer.tsx controls View uses pointerEvents='box-none' as JSX prop (deprecated on RN-web). Migrate to style.pointerEvents.

workout.tsx is 364 lines and contains the entire Exercises/Session/History UI plus 1 sub-component (SBStat). Approaching the 700-line ceiling but still well within readable size — no split needed yet.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 7 listed flows pass: zoom buttons tappable on both tabs, segmented nav, category chips, exercise list, exercise detail, start workout, session edit/addset/dup/done, rest-timer with all 4 presets/pause/skip, finish→summary with PRs+activation bars, summary-done, history listing, history re-open, Explore + Learn regression

seed_data_creation: Two test workouts created via UI flow inside the Playwright session (squat 3 sets and bench-press 1 set). AsyncStorage in a Playwright browser context does not persist across separate test invocations, so the history list appears empty in each fresh session — this is a test-harness limitation, not an app bug. In-session persistence (after router.replace + reopen via hist-<id>) is verified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: BUG FIX is confirmed visually: zoom/reset buttons live at top: insets.top + 64 in AnatomyViewer.tsx:196, which on this 390x844 viewport puts them at y=64 — clearly below the segmented header (y=8–46 on Workout) and Explore's title row. Workout flow IDs are deterministic and discoverable via [data-testid^="ex-"], [data-testid^="w-<exId>-"], etc. The Expo Router stack accumulation (3x seg-history elements after the full lifecycle) is cosmetic — always pick the visible (last) match in selectors. Persistence across Playwright sessions cannot be verified because each new browser context starts with a fresh IndexedDB; verified IN-session by reopening the summary from hist-<id>. Tap centre (~0.5, 0.45) of the viewer for reliable raycast on Explore.
